options.name: authentication_type
options.description: Choose default authentication type.

options.name: disabled_usrgroup
options.description: User group name to assign the deprovisioned user to. The user group must be disabled and cannot be enabled or deleted when configured. Required if C(ldap_jit_status) for C(saml_jit_status) enabled. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: http_auth_enabled
options.description: HTTP authentication will be enabled if C(true).

options.name: http_case_sensitive
options.description: Case sensitive login for HTTP authentication will be enabled if C(true).

options.name: http_login_form
options.description: Choose default login form.

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: http_strip_domains
options.description: A list of domain names that should be removed from the username.

options.name: jit_provision_interval
options.description: Time interval between JIT provision requests for logged-in user. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix with month and year support (3600s,60m,1h,1d,1M,1y). Minimum value 1h. Available only for LDAP provisioning. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: ldap_auth_enabled
options.description: LDAP authentication will be enabled if C(true). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: ldap_base_dn
options.description: Base DN of LDAP. This setting is required if current value of I(ldap_configured) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_bind_dn
options.description: Bind DN of LDAP. Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_bind_password
options.description: Bind password of LDAP. Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_case_sensitive
options.description: case sensitive login for LDAP authentication will be enabled if C(true).

options.name: ldap_configured
options.description: LDAP authentication will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: ldap_host
options.description: LDAP server name. e.g. C(ldap://ldap.zabbix.com) This setting is required if current value of I(ldap_configured) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_jit_status
options.description: Status of LDAP provisioning. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: ldap_port
options.description: A port number of LDAP server. This setting is required if current value of I(ldap_configured) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_search_attribute
options.description: Search attribute of LDAP. This setting is required if current value of I(ldap_configured) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix <= 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions. Please use community.zabbix.zabbix_user_directory module instead of this parameter with Zabbix >= 7.0.

options.name: ldap_userdirectory
options.description: LDAP authentication default user directory name for user groups with gui_access set to LDAP or System default. Required to be set when C(ldap_configured) / C(ldap_auth_enabled) is set to 1.

options.name: passwd_check_rules
options.description: Checking password rules. Select multiple from C(contain_uppercase_and_lowercase_letters), C(contain_digits). C(contain_special_characters) and C(avoid_easy_to_guess). This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.0.

options.name: passwd_min_length
options.description: Minimal length of password. Choose from 1-70. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.0.

options.name: saml_auth_enabled
options.description: SAML authentication will be enabled if C(true).

options.name: saml_case_sensitive
options.description: Case sensitive login for SAML authentication will be enabled if C(true).

options.name: saml_encrypt_assertions
options.description: SAML encrypt assertions will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_encrypt_nameid
options.description: SAML encrypt name ID will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_idp_entityid
options.description: SAML identify provider's entity ID. This setting is required if current value of I(saml_auth_enabled) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_jit_status
options.description: Status of SAML provisioning. This parameter is available since Zabbix 6.4.

options.name: saml_nameid_format
options.description: Name identifier format of SAML service provider. Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sign_assertions
options.description: SAML sign assertions will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sign_authn_requests
options.description: SAML sign AuthN requests will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sign_logout_requests
options.description: SAML sign logout requests will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sign_logout_responses
options.description: SAML sign logout responses will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sign_messages
options.description: SAML sign messages will be enabled if C(true). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_slo_url
options.description: URL for SAML single logout service. Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sp_entityid
options.description: Entity ID of SAML service provider. This setting is required if current value of I(saml_auth_enabled) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_sso_url
options.description: URL for single sign on service of SAML. This setting is required if current value of I(saml_auth_enabled) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.

options.name: saml_username_attribute
options.description: User name attribute of SAML. This setting is required if current value of I(saml_auth_enabled) is C(false). Works only with Zabbix = 6.0 and is silently ignored in higher versions.
